system.title: C: drive cleaner
system.subtitle: Clear Windows temp folders, Prefetch data and update leftovers. Your projects, documents and Downloads are never touched.

system.confirmBody: They are removed permanently, not moved to the Recycle Bin. Items marked as regenerable are rebuilt by Windows automatically.
system.stopAfterStep: Stop after the current Windows step
system.automatedBody: Windows Task Scheduler runs a quick cleanup on a schedule, with the highest rights your account allows and without any prompt. The app can remove the task again at any time.
system.scheduleMissing: Windows has no task for this schedule. Save again to repair it.
system.cleanmgrBody: Launch the built-in Windows Disk Cleanup wizard or configure and run saved profile 1 without typing CMD commands.
